units.source_text: 接着，夏天里他又回到她们所在的旅馆。

en.t: Then, during the summer, he returned once again to the inn where they were staying.

units.source_text: 今年秋天，他总是跟随在阿雪后边，同她一起去关客房的挡雨板，洗刷澡塘，拾掇客人的床铺。

en.t: This autumn, he was always following behind Ayuki, going with her to close the shutters of the guest rooms, scrub the bath, and straighten the guests' bedding.

units.source_text: 阿雪的舞蹈是在艺伎馆里学来的，他还成了阿雪舞蹈的观众。

en.t: Ayuki had learned her dancing at a geisha house, and he also became an audience for her dances.
